session_revocation_defect.cause: Server Supabase clients used SDK defaults (auto_refresh_token, persist_session). Every sign-in/refresh through the API stored that trainer's session and renewed it on a background timer 10 s before expiry; the trainer's own client then presented the rotated refresh token, Supabase reuse detection revoked the whole session and the Launcher was signed out and stopped syncing.
session_revocation_defect.signature: rotation exactly 3600-10 s after the previous one, a second rotation 0.1-0.4 s later (timer get_session + refresh), then whole-session revocation on the client's next renewal
session_revocation_defect.fix: app/repositories/supabase/http.py create_client: SyncClientOptions(auto_refresh_token=False, persist_session=False); app/auth/supabase_adapter.py get_user refuses an empty token instead of the SDK's stored-session fallback
session_revocation_defect.requires: API deployment only; no migration, web or Launcher release
